entries.orientation_source: monotonicity of the metric class frozen normalize() over a raw grid -- ClustOpt normalises every metric to higher-is-better, so an increasing normalize means the raw metric is MAXIMIZE and a decreasing one means MINIMIZE. Not inferred from names, signs or outcomes.
